aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (tablet) in Asia at 92.12% (market share of tracked page views / usage). YANDEX yandex.com.tr ranked second at 1.2%, followed by Baidu m.baidu.com at 1.15%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (tablet) in Asia?

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (tablet) in Asia?
